meta.title: Decision readiness: one row per requirement
meta.basis: Status is measured against files in this repository on branch arena/a72f5c83-korea2 (base 5da59c9). No external page was fetched from this session: the sandbox shell cannot reach nfl.com. Official sources listed here are the ones already recorded in committed registers; they are linked for manual review and were NOT re-opened in this session.

status_key.Built: The mechanism exists in the repo and its output is committed.
status_key.Partial: Some of the requirement exists; the named gap is listed.
status_key.Not built: No mechanism or output found in the repo.
status_key.Blocked: Cannot start until the named source or decision exists.
status_key.Not met: The mechanism exists but its output fails the requirement today.
status_key.Not located: The input the requirement refers to is not in the repo.

meta.policy: Blank or flagged, never inferred. A row whose status is not Built carries the number that would clear it, so the gap is measurable.
